meta.title: Plasticity CAD Bridge
meta.description: Native CAD modeling in Plasticity 26.1.3: scene reading and B-rep measurement, box/cylinder/sphere, extrude, boolean, fillet and chamfer, transform, undo/redo, STEP/STL/3MF/OBJ export, viewport screenshots. All units are mm and every write goes through Plasticity's own undoable command pipeline.
